About

A clinic operating system — not a public directory.

Doctors My Agency builds Clinicos so independent clinics can run appointments, conversations and visits in one private workspace. Patients stay on that clinic’s account.

Front desk

WhatsApp, bookings and an AI receptionist that uses live calendar availability.

Clinical

Waiting, called, consultation, vitals, prescription and follow-up on the same visit.

Trust

Owner-only controls stay owner-only. SaaS billing is not mixed with visit fees.

WhatsApp Business

Clinics connect their own WhatsApp Business account through Meta Embedded Signup when they are ready. Until then, the product shows that WhatsApp is not configured — it does not pretend to be live.
